mapper.select: SELECT user_id, email, password, name, nick, phone, role, refresh_token, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET name = #{request.name}, nick = #{request.nick}, phone = #{request.phone}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user SET refresh_token = NULL, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user SET password = #{encodedPassword}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT image_url FROM agent_image WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY image_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM agent_image WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_image ( user_id, image_url, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{profileImageUrl}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_image SET image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT p.property_id AS propertyId, pi.image_url AS thumbnailUrl, p.property_type AS propertyType, p.transaction_type AS transactionType, p.price AS price, p.deposit AS deposit, p.monthly_rent AS monthlyRent, p.area_m2 AS areaM2, p.floor AS floor, p.maintenance_fee AS maintenanceFee, p.status AS status, CONCAT(r.sido, ' ', r.sigungu, ' ', r.dong) AS regionName, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM property p LEFT JOIN region r ON p.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN property_image pi ON p.property_id = pi.property_id AND pi.is_thumbnail = 1 AND pi.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT report_id AS reportId, property_id AS propertyId, reason AS reason, status AS status, created_at AS createdAt FROM report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
